Start date: 1386-10-13 (Gregorian calendar).  
47 weeks = 47 × 7 = 329 days.  
Add 1 more day → total 330 days.  

1386 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, since it's before 1582 Gregorian leap year rules apply? Actually, Gregorian rules started 1582, but for pre-1582 dates we use proleptic Gregorian).  
Proleptic Gregorian: 1386 is not divisible by 4 → 365 days/year.  

From 1386-10-13:  
Days left in 1386: Oct 31–13 = 18, Nov 30, Dec 31 → total 18+30+31 = 79 days.  
330 − 79 = 251 days into 1387.  

1387 is not divisible by 4 → 365 days/year.  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days.  
251 − 243 = 8 days into September → 1387-09-08.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1387-09-08
